dossier.title: Side Scan
briefing: Commander, I'm {PATRON} running {HERE}. An Anaconda is working a neighbor world. When you're out there, hold it on your scanner for twenty seconds. Keep it steady. Do not fire on it—this is surveillance work only.

watch.arrive: Hold the Anaconda on scanner at {TARGET} for twenty seconds.
watch.success: Anaconda held on scanner at {TARGET} successfully.
watch.fail: Failed to hold Anaconda on scanner at {TARGET}.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} at {WORLD} needs your scanner for surveillance work.

rumour.far: {PATRON} from {WORLD} is looking for scanner work on a nearby ship.
rumour.near: {PATRON} at {WORLD} calling: bring your scanner, I have work for you.

dossier.news: {PATRON} at {WORLD} has surveillance work available to qualified pilots.

story.opening: The commander accepted a surveillance contract at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: The target was held on scanner at {WORLD} by day {DAY}, and the contract was complete.
closing.fail: The surveillance contract could not be completed at {WORLD} by day {DAY}.

watch.success: The Anaconda held on scanner at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
watch.targetDestroyed: The target was destroyed at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
watch.targetEscaped: The target escaped into jump space at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
watch.failed: The twenty-second hold deadline was missed at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.
